model_proof.records: Exactly N*(D+12) bytes after complete permutation; 78000000 at100k/768.
model_proof.pq: pq64_nominee.rs fit_source_codes allocates 64N code bytes and 64*256*ceil(D/64) f32 books, validated again by Pq64Codes::new. encode_pq writes24-byte header+4*books.len+codes.len; at100k/768=7186456.
model_proof.graph: PqVectorGraph::build rejects heap_bytes>512N before graph file creation. On the qualified x86_64 target heap_bytes=24*outer_capacity+sum(24*tower_capacity+4*edge_capacity). Length<=capacity. write_authenticated emits132 header bytes+N tower-count bytes+2L degree bytes+4E edges; thus encoded<=132+heap_bytes<=132+512N=51200132. This is independent of optimistic assumed degree or graph topology.
model_proof.manifest: serde body is checked <=65536 before write_body; larger metadata is not written.
model_proof.remainder: At maximum geometry, books/header/graph header/manifest/group rounding <=786432+24+132+65536+30=852154 <4194304. Single-body exact conservative sum at100k/768 is137452124 <=140794304.
model_proof.coexistence: Publication hard-links staged files into an empty output directory before tempdir drops. One serial builder means two completed layouts plus at most one additional active staging name set: <=3*140794304=422382912 logical bytes. Runtime intentionally counts hard links by name. Prospective filesystem growth is also conservatively charged by D+R; no max(directory,growth) substitution.
model_proof.native_output_bound: Unchanged native output_bound=2*(N*(D+12+512+64+8+2)+4MiB)=281588608 covers active staging+published names. Existing max_output_bytes=512MiB stays unchanged; the roster uses the independently proved per-layout bound, not that configuration limit.
model_proof.filesystem_reserve: R explicitly covers outside-root bootstrap/install writes, allocation/metadata overhead and cumulative deleted-temp-file growth beyond D. It consumes the same8GiB cap. Root must choose/substantiate R for the prospective environment; the test uses256MiB as an illustrative declared envelope, not empirical bootstrap qualification.
